page_title: DOR 1-1 BAY | Dortmund v Bayern Munich 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+4' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

90+3' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
90+3' What was Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+1' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) is flagged for offside.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Here's the change. Marcel Sabitzer leaves the pitch and Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) comes on as a substitute.
89' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
88' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) was probably a bit loose with his words to Sven Jablonski, who decides to show him a yellow.
88' PENALTY APPEAL after Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
85' 1 - 1 Goal! Michael Olise picks out Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom left corner with a header from close range. 1:1.
84' A poor mid-range free-kick by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
83' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul after Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick to Bayern Munich.
81' The linesman signals that Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is coming onto the pitch as Min-Jae Kim cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' Nuri Sahin isn't happy on the touchline after referee Sven Jablonski shows him a yellow card.
80' Rough tackle by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) was too forceful with his tackle and Sven Jablonski interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
76' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich). The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
74' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
74' Nuri Sahin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yan Couto (Dortmund) replacing Julian Ryerson.
74' Today's match ends for Jamie Gittens who will be replaced by Donyell Malen (Dortmund).
73' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
72' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
72' The resulting free kick from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) ends up in the gloves of the keeper. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
71' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Sven Jablonski didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

68' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Gregor Kobel anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
68' 37:63 – the latest ball possession ratio.
64' The corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is hurriedly cleared.

64' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
63' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
63' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
62' Substitution. Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mathys Tel walks off.
62' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Konrad Laimer and he is replaced by Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich).

62' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Manuel Neuer makes a great save to stop his effort.

61' CHANCE! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Konrad Laimer. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
59' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
58' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
57' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich).
55' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
55' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
54' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.

50' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
50' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) prepares to take a corner kick.
50' Good clearance! Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
49' A pass into the box finds Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Gregor Kobel denies him.
49' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

47' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
46' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) meets a cross inside the box, but Gregor Kobel wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
45+2' Sven Jablonski blows for a foul after Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
43' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
41' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
41' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Sven Jablonski no option but to blow his whistle.
38' Manuel Neuer displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
37' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Gregor Kobel produces a wonderful reflex save.
36' 3:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
33' Vincent Kompany is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Harry Kane suffers an injury and Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) comes on.
32' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

27' 1 - 0 Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Manuel Neuer is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
26' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.

24' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Sven Jablonski with no other option than to blow for a foul.
22' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
19' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle. Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after dangerous play.
18' The manager makes a subsitution with Niklas Sule (Dortmund) coming on for Waldemar Anton.
16' The game is interrupted now, Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
11' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
11' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
10' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
9' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.

8' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Bayern Munich are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

8' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Gregor Kobel has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
5' The foul by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) was seen by Sven Jablonski who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Sven Jablonski was nominated as the referee for this game.
